title: ChipBlocks CPU cores manifest
description: Single source of truth for packaged CPU cores available as drop-in blocks on the canvas. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Distinct from blocks.yaml because a packaged CPU is imported open-source IP that we wrap, not a hand-authored Elaboratable. Each row must conform to a versioned CPU socket (chipblocks-cpu-socket-vN). Phase 0 is an empty array; row 1 (picorv32) lands with ADR-004 + Sprint 29.

source.description: Upstream repository URL for the imported IP.

license.description: License of the upstream IP. Must be permissive per project core constraint (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD / ISC / CC0). GPL / AGPL / LGPL excluded.

socket.description: CPU socket version this core conforms to. Versions defined in ADR-004.

size_estimate_luts.description: Approximate LUT count on iCE40HX8K. For shuttle-fit estimation.

size_estimate_transistors.description: Approximate transistor count on Sky130. For shuttle-tier-fit estimation.

vendored_path.description: Path to the vendored copy of the upstream IP within ChipBlocks (e.g. 'backend/cpu_cores/picorv32/picorv32.v').

adapter_path.description: Path to the Amaranth wrapper that adapts the upstream IP to the CPU socket interface.
